'''Screech lizards''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] which inhabited one of the three [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of [[Obri]] in the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]]. Their skin was of a bright [[Color/Legends|green]] color. [[Lanoree Brock]]'s [[Sword/Legends|sword]] had a leather sheath fashioned from the skin of one of these creatures.
